name: 269. A token histogram window that starts or ends mid-hour counts only the tokens inside it (token-histogram-window) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-5522 (PR5 preservation group 4c). Local fixture regression: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json with a Postgres logs_store and matview_refresh_interval 5s (the hourly matview exists only on Postgres), and tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream and pricing source. Two calls of upstream-cached-tokens (20 input of which 7 cached, 2 output) land in one hour with the window boundary between them. Over the whole hours the matview serves both; over a window opening or closing between them the bars sum to exactly one call, cached reads included, because the partial boundary hours come from the raw table. Before the fix the matview's whole hour was counted and each window read both calls.
